svg.title: 01 tool stands
svg.desc: Editable native text and vector geometry, transparent background. No embedded raster artwork.

text.data-source-text: Build a stand for each tool on the arm's grid. Put a merge block on each stand and a facing merge block on the tool body.

text.tspan: Build a stand for each tool on the arm's grid. Put a merge block on

text.data-source-text: Start with every tool securely merged to its stand. Leave room for the arm to approach each mount and withdraw.
